title: Vyper Learnings
tagline: I took time over the weekend explorering the vyper development cycle, including increasing my understanding of vyper contracts
description: I took time over the weekend explorering the vyper development cycle, including increasing my understanding of vyper contracts. In particular i was looking at the byte code compatibility of scroll zkevm test net and how you can compile vyper code along side solitity code and still deploy it!
